profile.headline: Principal C++ / Qt Engineer | Real-Time Visualization & Control Systems | RHEL | DDS | Multithreading | RAII / Modern C++ | Unreal Engine Tools & Visualization
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer -> Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a Principal-level C++ engineer specializing in Qt-based real-time visualization and control systems on RHEL platforms.
For more than a decade I’ve designed and built modular, multithreaded applications that manage live data from distributed hardware using RTI DDS, TCP, and custom telemetry frameworks.

My focus is maintainable architecture: thread-safe managers, dependency-injected adapters, and responsive Qt Widgets / Dock UIs that scale from prototype to deployment. I apply RAII and modern C++ (11–20) practices to every layer for safety and performance.

I’ve also completed formal coursework in Unreal Engine development, giving me hands-on experience with the C++ game framework, Blueprints, and 3D scene logic. That exposure strengthens my understanding of rendering pipelines and real-time simulation—skills I bring back into desktop visualization and simulation-tool work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer -> Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated RTI DDS communication layer into a large legacy command-and-control system to interface with new transmitter hardware while preserving existing functionality.
• Architected and implemented Qt-based widget displays providing real-time telemetry, system health, and control surfaces for the upgraded platform.
• Designed and developed a C++ middleware translator tool that bridges a FORTRAN-based OTH RX control application and next-generation DDS endpoints—supporting multiple concurrent TCP sessions and deterministic message translation between legacy and modern protocols.
• Built and maintained a suite of companion micro-tools and services leveraging RTI DDS and Qt Widgets for system-status monitoring and operator interfaces.
• Solely responsible for full lifecycle ownership—requirements capture, architecture, implementation, integration, and on-site test and delivery at multiple remote facilities.
• Collaborate directly with hardware, RF, and network engineering teams to validate end-to-end command, telemetry, and monitoring performance across distributed systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed tactical shipboard interfacing software in Java leveraging RTI DDS to capture operator input and relay actions to live, distributed fleet-training environments in real time.
• Designed and implemented FPGA-based hardware interfaces to acquire legacy ROLM and Serial bus data, perform TCP/IP conversion, and transmit it to distributed simulation systems.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as project engineer for the Marine Corps Supporting Arms Virtual Training (SAVT) system, overseeing requirements capture, technical design, and on-site integration and testing of simulation hardware and software.
• Designed and implemented a hardware/software interface to bridge existing VxWorks voice-communication equipment with new Windows-based systems, using C# and TCP for reliable command-data transfer.

positions.title: Modeling & Simulation Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with developers and analysts to design and implement discrete-event simulation tools using Java and the Eclipse Rich Client Platform (RCP) for shipbuilding process analysis.
• Served as Scrum Master, coordinating Agile sprints, prioritizing development tasks, and communicating progress to stakeholders and management.
• Developed analytical simulation models for manning, scheduling, and process optimization, enabling measurable efficiency gains and cost reductions across production workflows.
